[ASSISTANT_SAID] Research suggests female athletes may experience more severe concussions due to differences in anatomy and physiology, such as weaker neck muscles.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hormonal differences, such as the effects of estrogen and progesterone, may contribute to increased susceptibility to concussions in women.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These factors are not always consistent across different sports and individual cases, and more research is needed to understand the role of gender in concussion severity.
